privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How Sentinel collects, uses and protects the personal data processed as part of the service.
privacy.roles.title: Controller and processor
privacy.roles.body: Sentinel is an online service provided by the publisher identified in the legal notice. Responsibilities under the GDPR are allocated as follows.
privacy.roles.item.controller: Controller: the client organization subscribing to the service. It decides which projects are analysed, which users are invited and which data is entered in tickets.
privacy.roles.item.processor: Processor: the publisher of Sentinel, which processes that data solely on documented instructions from the client organization, under Article 28 of the GDPR.
privacy.roles.item.own: The publisher acts as controller for the management of its own customer accounts, billing and platform security.
privacy.data.title: Data processed
privacy.data.body: The service processes the following categories of data:
privacy.data.item.identity: Identity and account: first and last name, email address, role, parent organization, password stored as a BCrypt hash, interface language and theme.
privacy.data.item.activity: Application activity: tickets created or edited, comments, attachments, assignments and logged time.
privacy.data.item.technical: Technical data: audit logs (action, date, user, IP address), application logs, session and token identifiers.
privacy.data.item.billing: Billing data: subscribed plan, subscription status, Stripe customer and subscription identifiers, invoice history. No card data ever transits through our servers: it is handled directly by Stripe.
privacy.data.item.repositories: Repository data: URLs of analysed repositories, personal access tokens encrypted at rest, dependency manifests and related metadata. Source code is neither copied nor stored.
privacy.purposes.title: Purposes and legal bases
privacy.purposes.body: Each processing operation relies on a legal basis under Article 6 of the GDPR:
privacy.purposes.item.service: Providing the service — dependency analysis, health score, tickets and exports: performance of the contract.
privacy.purposes.item.account: Account creation and management, invitations, email verification: performance of the contract.
privacy.purposes.item.billing: Billing, subscription and quota management: performance of the contract and statutory accounting obligation.
privacy.purposes.item.security: Security, access logging and abuse prevention: the publisher's legitimate interest in protecting the platform.
privacy.purposes.item.support: Support and service communications, password reset, notifications: performance of the contract.
privacy.purposes.item.no_profiling: No solely automated decision producing legal effects is made. No data is sold or used for advertising purposes.
privacy.recipients.title: Recipients and processors
privacy.recipients.body: Data is accessible to authorised members of your organization and to the following providers, acting as sub-processors:
privacy.recipients.item.hosting: Hosting and database: Supabase, on Amazon Web Services infrastructure.
privacy.recipients.item.email: Transactional email: the SMTP provider configured by the publisher.
privacy.recipients.item.repos: Code hosts: GitHub and GitLab, queried with the access token you provide, solely to read dependency manifests.
privacy.recipients.item.feeds: Public sources queried without transmitting personal data: OSV for vulnerabilities, public package registries for versions, endoflife.date for lifecycle data.
privacy.recipients.item.transfers: Some providers may process data outside the European Union. Such transfers are governed by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.
privacy.cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
privacy.cookies.body: Sentinel uses neither advertising cookies nor third-party analytics trackers. Only mechanisms strictly necessary to operate the service are used, which are exempt from prior consent:
privacy.cookies.item.refresh: An HttpOnly, secure, SameSite-restricted authentication cookie holding the session refresh token.
privacy.cookies.item.storage: Browser local storage, to remember the selected interface language and theme.
privacy.retention.title: Retention periods
privacy.retention.body: Data is retained for the following periods, then deleted or anonymised:
privacy.retention.account.label: User account
privacy.retention.account.value: For the duration of the contract, then immediate deletion or pseudonymisation of identifying data.
privacy.retention.activity.label: Activity and tickets
privacy.retention.activity.value: Retained in anonymised form after account deletion, to preserve the integrity of the organization's history.
privacy.retention.audit.label: Audit logs
privacy.retention.audit.value: 12 months from the event, in line with CNIL recommendations.
privacy.retention.billing.label: Accounting records
privacy.retention.billing.value: 10 years, pursuant to Article L. 123-22 of the French Commercial Code.
privacy.retention.tokens.label: Revoked tokens
privacy.retention.tokens.value: Until their expiry date, then automatically purged.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.body: You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection and portability, as well as the right to issue directives on the fate of your data after your death.
privacy.rights.item.self_service: Access, rectification, data export and account deletion can be carried out directly from your profile.
privacy.rights.item.request: Other requests should be addressed to your organization's administrator or to support; a reply is provided within one month.
privacy.rights.item.complaint: You may lodge a complaint with the CNIL, 3 place de Fontenoy, 75007 Paris — www.cnil.fr.
privacy.rights.profile_link: Manage my data from my profile
privacy.security.title: Security
privacy.security.body: Appropriate technical and organisational measures protect the data processed:
privacy.security.item.transport: HTTPS encryption in transit and restricted authentication cookies.
privacy.security.item.auth: Passwords stored as BCrypt hashes, time-limited and revocable session tokens.
privacy.security.item.isolation: Strict isolation between organizations, enforced both in the application and directly by the database.
privacy.security.item.secrets: Repository access tokens encrypted at rest.
privacy.security.item.audit: Logging of access and sensitive actions.
privacy.contact.title: Contact
privacy.contact.body: For any question about data protection or to exercise your rights, contact your organization's administrator or the publisher at the address below. The publisher's full details are set out in the legal notice.

terms.title: Terms of service and sale
terms.subtitle: Rules governing access to Sentinel, subscription, billing and termination conditions.
terms.object.title: Purpose and acceptance
terms.object.body: These terms govern access to the Sentinel service, its use and subscription to paid plans. Creating an account or subscribing to a plan constitutes unreserved acceptance of these terms. They prevail over any other document, except for specific terms signed between the parties.
terms.service.title: Service description
terms.service.body: Sentinel is an online service for analysing the technical health of software projects. It notably offers:
terms.service.item.scan: connecting GitHub or GitLab repositories and analysing their dependency manifests;
terms.service.item.score: cross-referencing with public sources of vulnerabilities, versions and end-of-life data, and computing a health score;
terms.service.item.tickets: tracking corrective actions through tickets, SBOM exports and traceability reports;
terms.service.item.evolution: the publisher may evolve the features, provided it does not substantially degrade the subscribed service.
terms.account.title: Account and organization
terms.account.body: Registration creates an organization whose creator is the administrator. Each user is responsible for keeping their credentials confidential and for actions performed from their account.
terms.account.item.accuracy: Information provided at registration must be accurate and kept up to date; the email address must be verified to activate the account.
terms.account.item.roles: The administrator manages invitations, roles and account deactivation within their organization.
terms.account.item.security: Any unauthorised use of an account must be reported to support without delay.
terms.account.item.age: The service is reserved for professionals and persons of legal age.
terms.plans.title: Plans, quotas and pricing
terms.plans.body: The service is offered under several plans whose features, project and user quotas and current prices are displayed in the application before any subscription.
terms.plans.item.currency: Prices are stated in euros excluding tax; applicable VAT is added at payment.
terms.plans.item.quota: Exceeding a quota blocks the creation of new resources until the plan is changed.
terms.plans.item.change: Plan changes take effect immediately, with pro-rata adjustment over the current period.
terms.plans.item.price_change: Any price change is notified at least thirty days before it takes effect and entitles the client to terminate free of charge.
terms.billing.title: Billing and payment
terms.billing.body: Subscriptions are managed by the payment provider Stripe. No card data is stored by the publisher.
terms.billing.item.cycle: The subscription is billed in advance on a monthly basis and renews automatically at each term.
terms.billing.item.invoice: Invoices are made available in the billing area of the service.
terms.billing.item.failure: If a payment fails, access to paid features may be suspended after an unsuccessful reminder.
terms.billing.item.no_refund: Started periods are not refundable, except where mandatory law provides otherwise.
terms.duration.title: Term and termination
terms.duration.body: The contract is entered into for the current subscription period and renews by tacit agreement.
terms.duration.item.client: The client may terminate at any time from the billing portal; termination takes effect at the end of the current period.
terms.duration.item.effect: At the end of the contract, access to paid features ceases; data may be exported before deletion.
terms.duration.item.breach: The publisher may suspend or terminate access in the event of a serious breach of these terms, after a formal notice left unanswered for fifteen days, except in a security emergency.
terms.withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal
terms.withdrawal.body: The service is aimed at professionals acting in the course of their business, for whom the statutory right of withdrawal does not apply. Where the subscriber is a consumer, they have fourteen days from subscription to withdraw; by requesting immediate access to the service, they waive that right for the part of the service already performed.
terms.obligations.title: User obligations
terms.obligations.body: Users undertake to use the service fairly. The following are prohibited:
terms.obligations.item.rights: analysing repositories for which the necessary access rights are not held;
terms.obligations.item.tokens: disclosing to third parties the access tokens stored in the service;
terms.obligations.item.security: any attempt at unauthorised access, quota circumvention or interference with the availability and integrity of the platform;
terms.obligations.item.content: uploading unlawful content in tickets, comments or attachments;
terms.obligations.item.resale: reselling or making the service available to third parties without written authorisation.
terms.ip.title: Intellectual property and client data
terms.ip.body: The publisher grants a personal, non-exclusive and non-transferable right to use the service for the duration of the subscription. The client retains full ownership of the data it enters or connects and grants the publisher the rights strictly necessary to perform the service. Aggregated and anonymised data may be used for statistical purposes and to improve the service.
terms.availability.title: Availability and maintenance
terms.availability.body: The publisher uses reasonable efforts to ensure the availability of the service, without any service level commitment unless separately agreed in writing. Interruptions may occur for maintenance, updates or external causes; scheduled interruptions are announced where possible.

terms.law.title: Governing law and disputes
terms.law.body: These terms are governed by French law. The parties will seek an amicable solution before any legal action. Failing agreement, the dispute will be brought before the competent courts; where the client is a consumer, they may use a consumer mediator or the European online dispute resolution platform free of charge.
